user.title: Connect to Magister
user.description: Log in with the Magister account of a parent or student. Accounts that sign in through school SSO or a passkey are not supported.

data_description.school: The school name (for example `myschool`), its Magister host name (`myschool.magister.net`) or the web address.
data_description.username: The username you use to log in to Magister.
data_description.totp_secret: Only for accounts with two-step verification: the secret (base32 text) shown when the authenticator app was set up.

children.title: Choose children
children.description: Each selected child gets a calendar.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Magister again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} at {school} no longer works. Enter the current password. Only fill in the authenticator secret when it changed.

data_description.password: The current password of this account.
data_description.totp_secret: Leave empty to keep the saved secret.

reconfigure.title: Change the Magister login
reconfigure.description: Change the login of the account at {school}. It must be the same Magister account. Leave the password or secret empty to keep the saved one.

error.invalid_school: This is not a valid Magister school name.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password is not correct.
error.totp_required: This account requires two-step verification. Enter the authenticator secret.
error.invalid_totp: The authenticator secret is not valid or the code was rejected.
error.unsupported_login: This school or account uses a login method that is not supported (school SSO or passkey).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Magister. Try again later.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details.
error.login_page_changed: Magister changed its login page, so logging in is not possible right now. Update the integration or try again later.
error.child_already_configured: This child is already added under another login of this school. Add each child under one login only.

abort.already_configured: This Magister account is already configured.
abort.no_children: No children were found on this account.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Magister account. Add that account as a new integration instead.
abort.reauth_successful: Logged in again. The integration is reloading.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The login was updated. The integration is reloading.
abort.all_children_configured: All children of this account are already added under another login of this school.

auth_failed.message: Logging in to Magister failed. Check the credentials.

login_blocked.message: Logging in to Magister is blocked after repeated failures. Reload the integration to try once more, or use Reconfigure to change the credentials.

homework_item_not_found.message: This homework item does not exist (any more) in the list.

homework_status_only.message: Only the status of a homework item can be changed; the items come from Magister.

homework_appointment_not_found.message: This appointment does not exist (any more) in the fetched agenda.

homework_label_not_found.message: This label is not one of the labels configured for this child.

homework_label_exists.message: This appointment already has this label.

homework_label_not_on_appointment.message: This appointment does not have this manual label. Magister labels cannot be removed.

homework_item_disabled.message: This homework item has no active labels (its Magister label is disabled). Restore the label first.

homework_no_magister_label.message: This appointment has no Magister label (Huiswerk, Proefwerk, Tentamen, SO or MO) to replace or disable.

init.title: Magister options
init.description: What do you want to change?

general.title: Magister options
general.description: Choose the children, how much of the agenda is fetched and how often it is refreshed.

data_description.weeks_back: 0 to 8 weeks before the current week.
data_description.weeks_ahead: 1 to 12 weeks after the current week. First-appointment sensors can look at most 7 x this number - 1 days ahead.

weights.title: Homework weights
weights.description: Choose the child. The weights decide how much an item counts in the homework progress sensors.

weights_types.title: Weights per type
weights_types.description: How much each type counts for {child}. 1 is normal, 0 leaves it out of the average (it stays in the list), 10 is the maximum. Steps of 0.5.

weights_labels.title: Weights per label
weights_labels.description: How much each custom label counts for {child}. 1 is normal, 0 leaves it out of the average. The Magister names (Huiswerk, Proefwerk, ...) use the type weights, also when renamed. An item with several labels counts with its highest label weight. Steps of 0.5.

weights_subjects.title: Weights per subject
weights_subjects.description: How much each subject counts. 1 is normal, 0 leaves it out of the average. Subjects that are not in the data now keep their saved weight.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Choose the child. These are the labels you can add to a lesson in the homework card.

labels_menu.title: Labels of {child}
labels_menu.description: What do you want to do?

menu_options.label_edit: Rename a label or change its kind

label_add.title: Add a label
label_add.description: A label has a name and a kind: homework or test (a test counts as a test in the progress). Set its weight under Homework weights.

label_edit.title: Choose a label
label_edit.description: Which label of {child} do you want to change?

label_edit_details.title: Change label
label_edit_details.description: Change the name or the kind of "{label}".

label_delete.title: Delete a label
label_delete.description: Which label of {child} do you want to delete? A label that is still on a lesson cannot be deleted.

error.child_already_configured: This child is already added under another login of this school. Add each child under one login only.
error.label_in_use: This label is still used on one or more lessons, as a label or as a replacement. Remove it there first.
error.name_too_long: The name can be at most 40 characters.
error.name_exists: This child already has a label with this name.

abort.auth_failed: Logging in to Magister failed. Use the re-login card or reconfigure first.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not read the children from Magister. Try again later.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Wait until it is running and try again.

user.title: First-appointment sensor
user.description: A sensor with the start time of the first appointment of a day, for example for a wake-up automation. Day 0 is today, 1 is tomorrow. At most {max_offset} days ahead fit in the fetched window.

data_description.name: Leave empty for a name based on the day.

reconfigure.title: Edit first-appointment sensor
reconfigure.description: At most {max_offset} days ahead fit in the fetched window.

excluded.title: Excluded subjects
excluded.description: Appointments with these subjects are skipped. Matching is exact, ignoring upper and lower case. You can type other subjects too.

error.offset_outside_window: This day is outside the fetched window (at most {max_offset} days ahead). Increase the weeks ahead in the options first.

login_page_changed.title: Magister changed its login page
login_page_changed.description: The login for {entry} no longer works because Magister changed its login page. Update the integration (HACS) to the latest version. If the problem remains, report it on the issue tracker.

offset_outside_window.title: First-appointment sensor outside the window
offset_outside_window.description: The sensor {name} looks {offset} days ahead, but only {max_offset} days fit in {weeks_ahead} weeks ahead. The sensor is unknown. Increase the weeks ahead in the options or edit the sensor.

child_in_multiple_entries.title: Several logins list the same child
child_in_multiple_entries.description: A child is configured under more than one Magister login for this school. Remove it from one login: open Configure on that login and deselect the child.

homework_next_week_outside_window.title: Homework: next week is outside the window
homework_next_week_outside_window.description: The sensor "Homework next week" of {entry} needs at least 2 weeks ahead, but {weeks_ahead} is set. The sensor is unavailable. Increase the weeks ahead in the options.

set_homework_progress.name: Set homework progress
set_homework_progress.description: Sets the progress of a homework item in percent. 100 marks it as done. Nothing is written to Magister.

item.name: Item
item.description: The id (uid) of the homework item in the to-do list.

add_homework_label.name: Add homework label
add_homework_label.description: Adds a manual label to an appointment. The appointment appears in the homework planner with this label. Nothing is written to Magister.

appointment.name: Appointment
appointment.description: The id (uid) of the appointment: host:childId:appointmentId, for example myschool.magister.net:1001:100070.

label.name: Label
label.description: The id or the name (not case-sensitive) of one of the labels configured for this child.

note.name: Note
note.description: An optional short note, at most 200 characters.

remove_homework_label.name: Remove homework label
remove_homework_label.description: Removes a manual label from an appointment. Labels from Magister cannot be removed.

label.name: Label
label.description: The id or the name (not case-sensitive) of the label.

set_homework_override.name: Set homework label override
set_homework_override.description: Replaces or disables the Magister label of an appointment, or restores it. Nothing is written to Magister.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Replace the label, disable it, or clear (restore) the override.

label.name: Label
label.description: For replace: the id or the name (not case-sensitive) of one of the labels configured for this child.
